categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: electronic components distribution, chip design and manufacturing, software development and sales, and smart control products for household appliances. The electronic components distribution segment is the largest, serving industries such as consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and medical. The chip design and manufacturing segment focuses on MEMS micro-mirrors and automotive display driver chips (DDIC and TDDI). Software development includes ERP, MES, and WMS systems tailored for electronics manufacturing and distribution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor design and manufacturing technologies, including MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) micro-mirror technology with electromagnetic drive for laser scanning applications. It also develops automotive-grade display driver integrated circuits (DDIC and TDDI) with high precision touch capabilities. The manufacturing involves IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) and fabless models, with local wafer production and packaging to optimize cost and supply chain. Software products are developed using AI technologies integrating large language models for intelligent customer service and data analysis.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in consumer electronics, automotive (especially new energy vehicles), industrial automation, medical devices, and smart home sectors. The company serves major markets in China and internationally, with significant sales in mobile phones, automotive electronics, industrial robots, and smart transportation. The software segment targets electronics manufacturing and distribution enterprises, including group companies and MIM industry clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, with substantial business in Hong Kong, Japan, and the United States. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Tokyo, and the US, supporting local manufacturing and sales. Overseas sales account for nearly half of total revenue, reflecting a broad international market presence. The company also benefits from local supply chain advantages in China for semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both midstream and downstream in the electronics supply chain. It acts as a distributor connecting upstream original manufacturers with downstream customers, providing technical support and logistics. Concurrently, it is expanding upstream into semiconductor IDM activities, including chip design, wafer fabrication, and packaging. This vertical integration aims to provide end-to-end semiconductor solutions and enhance domestic supply chain security.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on transforming from a distributor to a full semiconductor IDM enterprise integrating R&D, manufacturing, and sales. R&D priorities include MEMS micro-mirror product development for automotive lidar and industrial applications, and automotive-grade DDIC and TDDI chips to capture the growing vehicle display market. The company is increasing R&D investment significantly, expanding its chip product portfolio, and pursuing AI-enabled software solutions. It also plans to accelerate market penetration through strategic partnerships and potential acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic components and semiconductor chips, including distribution commissions and product sales. The company also earns income from software licensing, sales, and maintenance services. It employs a direct sales model complemented by agency and procurement arrangements, serving both large OEMs and smaller customers. The chip business uses a combination of direct supply and distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Taiwanese and Korean suppliers in automotive display driver chips but is emerging as a leading domestic alternative with localized supply chain advantages. In electronic components distribution, it is one of the largest and most diversified players in China with extensive upstream and downstream customer relationships. Its chip design and MEMS capabilities position it as a rising competitor in the domestic semiconductor industry, aiming to capitalize on the national push for technology self-reliance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.35 billion, a 7.83% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 60.27 million, up 9.84%. The chip design and manufacturing segment grew by over 25%, reflecting rapid expansion. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 3.59 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year. R&D expenses surged by 155.99%, indicating strong investment in innovation. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with improving profitability and cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop service capability combining electronic component distribution with in-house semiconductor design and manufacturing, enabling cost-effective and secure supply chain solutions. Its MEMS micro-mirror technology offers compact, low-power, and high-precision products suitable for automotive lidar and industrial applications. The automotive display driver chips provide superior touch performance under challenging conditions and support emerging display trends like HUD. The company’s strong local presence and integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities differentiate it from foreign competitors, supporting domestic substitution and innovation.
